title: Velocity at third quadrant
description: Essential: Correctly applies work-energy theorem to find speed from electric field work: v = sqrt(2qEa/m).

title: Magnetic field motion time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates time from entry to point B as half the cyclotron period: t = π(a+b) / (2 sqrt(2qEa/m)).

title: Highest point velocity
description: Essential: States that speed at highest point in first quadrant equals speed entering first quadrant: v = sqrt(2qEa/m).

title: Highest point coordinates
description: Essential: Correctly computes coordinates from kinematics in first quadrant: (b + sqrt(2)a, sqrt(2)a).

title: Magnetic force analysis
description: Important: Recognizes semicircular path in magnetic field and relates radius to given geometry: R = (a+b)/2.

title: First quadrant kinematics
description: Important: Correctly decomposes electric force at 45° and applies kinematics to find parabolic trajectory peak.

title: Energy conservation reasoning
description: Optional: Explicitly notes conservation of energy in electric fields or work-energy steps.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies direction of magnetic force, electric force components, or velocity vectors.

title: Unit or expression mishandling
description: Pitfall: Omits units, misplaces constants, or makes algebraic errors in final expressions.
